verdict.rationale: kitty documents startup sessions to 'specify working environments' [kitty-docs-27], so you can predefine windows and tabs to open at launch. The hands-on probe shows `kitten @ ls` dumps the full window/tab/layout state as JSON [kitty-probe-rt-1], which could feed a scripted save-and-restore. Nothing in the evidence shows automatic restoration of the actual previous session after a restart or crash. Missing for 10: automatic session save/restore after restart or crash, documented restoration of working directories, independent or hands-on corroboration of restore working end to end.
